parts.content: Write code in the workspace to implement task_007 only. You are expected to edit files. Implement 18 deterministic pure RuleInterface subclasses in module_2_audit_engine/rules/diagnosis_rules.py (RULE-COND-001..004), medication_rules.py (RULE-MED-001..005), and encounter_rules.py (RULE-ENC-001, RULE-ENC-002, RULE-PROC-001, RULE-PROC-002, RULE-OBS-001, RULE-OBS-002, RULE-CARE-001..003). Create data/rule_packs/contradiction_rules_v1.yaml definitions matching all rule ids, version 1.0.0, categories, names/descriptions. Use RuleMetadata and execute(resources: List[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> List[Mapping[str, Any]]. Findings must be safety-validator compatible: no clinical action language; use keys rule_id, severity allowed values info/warning/critical (map HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW only conceptually; output warning/critical/info), category, narrative, evidence list of mappings, status active. Never mutate resources and preserve input order. Avoid datetime.now/random/UUID and external dependencies. For date comparisons use ISO date parse helper. For future-date checks use optional reference date from resource.get('meta', {}).get('auditReferenceDate'); skip rule if absent/invalid to preserve determinism. Need robust nested FHIR status access: Condition clinicalStatus text/coding/status, MedicationStatement and MedicationRequest status, period start/end, dosageInstruction doseAndRate doseQuantity.value. Directly satisfy taskâ€™s stated logic where feasible. Do not touch unrelated files or task markdown. Add concise docstrings. Run a narrow compile/test command if you can. In final report list files changed and any known caveats.
